info.title: Gorgias
info.description: Simulated Gorgias API for deterministic AutomationBench workflow evaluation.

get.summary: Retrieve a collection of support tickets from Gorgias. Fetch and browse helpdesk ticket records.
get.description: Retrieve a collection of support tickets from Gorgias. Fetch and browse helpdesk ticket records.

post.summary: Open a new helpdesk ticket in Gorgias. Submit a ticket with a subject line, the customer's email address, and message content.

200.description: {id: int, subject: string, channel: string, status: string, customer: object, messages: array, message_count: int, tags: array, assignee_user_id: string, created_at: string, updated_at: string}

post.description: Open a new helpdesk ticket in Gorgias. Submit a ticket with a subject line, the customer's email address, and message content. Request body: Body: {subject (optional, string), channel (optional, string — 'aircall'|'api'|'chat'|'contact_form'|'email'|'facebook'|'facebook-mention'|'facebook-messenger'|'facebook-recommendations'|'help-center'|'instagram-ad-comment'|'instagram-comment'|'instagram-direct-message'|'instagram-mention'|'internal-note'|'phone'|'sms'|'twitter'|'twitter-direct-message'|'whatsapp'|'yotpo-review', default 'email'), via (required, string — 'api'|'email'|'helpdesk'|'chat'|'sms'), customer (optional, object — {email, name}), messages (required, array of {body_text, body_html, channel, from_agent (bool), via} — minimum 1 item), tags (optional, array of {name} objects), from_agent (optional, boolean)}.

schema.description: Body: {subject (optional, string), channel (optional, string — 'aircall'|'api'|'chat'|'contact_form'|'email'|'facebook'|'facebook-mention'|'facebook-messenger'|'facebook-recommendations'|'help-center'|'instagram-ad-comment'|'instagram-comment'|'instagram-direct-message'|'instagram-mention'|'internal-note'|'phone'|'sms'|'twitter'|'twitter-direct-message'|'whatsapp'|'yotpo-review', default 'email'), via (required, string — 'api'|'email'|'helpdesk'|'chat'|'sms'), customer (optional, object — {email, name}), messages (required, array of {body_text, body_html, channel, from_agent (bool), via} — minimum 1 item), tags (optional, array of {name} objects), from_agent (optional, boolean)}

put.summary: Modify an existing ticket in Gorgias. Update the ticket's status (open/closed) or reassign its tags.

200.description: {id: int, subject: string, channel: string, status: string, customer: object, messages: array, message_count: int, tags: array, assignee_user_id: string, created_at: string, updated_at: string}

parameters.name: ticket_id
parameters.description: Identifier of the ticket to modify.

put.description: Modify an existing ticket in Gorgias. Update the ticket's status (open/closed) or reassign its tags. Request body: {status (optional, string — 'open'|'closed'), tags (optional, array of {name: string} objects — e.g. [{name: 'urgent'}, {name: 'vip'}]), subject (optional, string), priority (optional, string — 'critical'|'high'|'normal'|'low')}.

schema.description: {status (optional, string — 'open'|'closed'), tags (optional, array of {name: string} objects — e.g. [{name: 'urgent'}, {name: 'vip'}]), subject (optional, string), priority (optional, string — 'critical'|'high'|'normal'|'low')}

post.summary: Append a message or reply to an existing Gorgias ticket. Post a response to a customer's support request.

200.description: {id: int, body_text: string, body_html: string, channel: string, from_agent: bool, created_datetime: string}

parameters.name: ticket_id
parameters.description: Identifier of the ticket to append the message to.

post.description: Append a message or reply to an existing Gorgias ticket. Post a response to a customer's support request. Request body: Body: {body_text (optional, string), body_html (optional, string), channel (required, string — 'aircall'|'api'|'chat'|'contact_form'|'email'|'facebook'|'facebook-mention'|'facebook-messenger'|'facebook-recommendations'|'help-center'|'instagram-ad-comment'|'instagram-comment'|'instagram-direct-message'|'instagram-mention'|'internal-note'|'phone'|'sms'|'twitter'|'twitter-direct-message'|'whatsapp'|'yotpo-review'), from_agent (required, boolean — true for agent message, false for customer), via (required, string — 'api'|'email'|'helpdesk'|'chat'|'sms'), subject (optional, string), public (optional, boolean, default true)}.

schema.description: Body: {body_text (optional, string), body_html (optional, string), channel (required, string — 'aircall'|'api'|'chat'|'contact_form'|'email'|'facebook'|'facebook-mention'|'facebook-messenger'|'facebook-recommendations'|'help-center'|'instagram-ad-comment'|'instagram-comment'|'instagram-direct-message'|'instagram-mention'|'internal-note'|'phone'|'sms'|'twitter'|'twitter-direct-message'|'whatsapp'|'yotpo-review'), from_agent (required, boolean — true for agent message, false for customer), via (required, string — 'api'|'email'|'helpdesk'|'chat'|'sms'), subject (optional, string), public (optional, boolean, default true)}
